root_cause.text: The `octeontx2-af` driver fails to validate whether the shared firmware data structure (`rvu->fwdata`) is successfully mapped (i.e., not NULL) before dereferencing it in `rvu_sdp_init()` and `rvu_mbox_handler_cgx_set_link_mode()`, leading to a null pointer dereference on boards booted without a MAC block.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds explicit NULL checks for `rvu->fwdata` in `rvu_sdp_init()` (`if (rvu->fwdata && rvu->fwdata->channel_data.valid)`) and in `rvu_mbox_handler_cgx_set_link_mode()` (`if (!rvu->fwdata) return LMAC_AF_ERR_FIRMWARE_DATA_NOT_MAPPED;`) to prevent kernel panics when accessing the unmapped firmware structure.
